title: Home guide: taking a pulse
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 22 (Home practical guide and safety card: taking a pulse (portal worksheet; gentle stepping only, stop if unwell))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how exercise changes heart rate and how quickly it recovers.
equipment: A timer or clock with a second hand
safety: Gentle stepping only, on the bottom stair or a sturdy step
Stop at once if you feel unwell, dizzy or out of breath
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Sit still for 2 minutes. Find your pulse on your wrist with two fingers.
Count the beats in 15 seconds and multiply by 4. Do this 3 times for your resting rate.
Step gently up and down for 1 minute.
Measure your pulse straight away, then every minute for 4 minutes.
